meta.promptText: Mujhe India mein 3000 rupees ke andar running shoes kharidne hain. Konse lene chahiye?

response.text:
Bharat mein 3,000 rupees ke budget mein running shoes ke liye kayi acche aur reliable options available hain. Is price range mein aapko **Campus**, **Sparx**, **Red Tape**, aur **Nivia** jaise brands ke comfortable aur durable shoes mil jayenge jo daily running aur walking ke liye best hain.

Neeche kuch behtareen options ki list di gayi hai:

---

### Top Running Shoes Under 3,000 Rupees in India

| Brand & Model | Key Features | Best For | Approx. Price |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Campus OGs / Running Series** | Lightweight, good cushioning, breathable mesh upper | Daily jogging & casual gym workouts | Rs. 1,500 - Rs. 2,500 |
| **Sparx Running Shoes** | Durable sole, firm grip, strong build quality | Rough use, road running & walking | Rs. 1,200 - Rs. 2,200 |
| **Red Tape Sports Shoes** | Stylish design, comfortable in-sole, shock absorption | Casual wear & light running | Rs. 1,800 - Rs. 2,800 |
| **Nivia Engage / Vizag** | Designed specifically for sports/running, flexible sole | Sports practice, track running | Rs. 1,000 - Rs. 2,000 |

---

### Key Tips to Choose the Right Pair:

* **Breathability:** Mesh upper wale shoes chunen taaki running ke dauran pairo mein zyada sweat na ho.
* **Cushioning:** Agar aap road par running karte hain, toh thoda soft sole (good cushioning) wala shoe select karein taaki ghutno (knees) par pressure kam pade.
* **Size:** Running shoes hamesha apne regular shoe size se **ek size bada** (ya half size bada) kharidein, kyunki daudte waqt pair thode expand hote hain.

---

Aapka primary use kya hoga (jaise ki daily road running, gym, ya sirf morning walk)? Aur aapka shoe size kya hai?
